title: Order stages
description: Optional steps of your own (e.g. Packing) shown to buyers while an order is “{accepted}”. The order lifecycle itself is fixed.
readOnly: Only owners and admins can change stages.
name: Name
duplicate: A stage with this name already exists (retired ones included).
retireDescription: It can no longer be assigned and can't be restored. Orders currently in this stage keep it.
limit: Up to {max} stages, retired ones included.
limitReached: The limit of {max} stages (retired included) is reached.
